subsection: H. Directors and Officers Liability (D&O) Insurance
text: Nonetheless, Ins.C. § 533 bars indemnification for “loss resulting from the wilful act of the insured” (see ¶ 3:105 ff.). This has been interpreted to bar coverage under CGL policies for claims of sexual harassment (see ¶ 3:447) and tortious termination of employment in violation of public policy (Tameny claims) (see ¶ 3:426). The same result would likely apply to coverage under D&O policies. [3:697 - 3:704] Reserved. 5. Allocation of Defense and Settlement Costs a. [3:705] Joinder of claims: Where claims covered under a D&O policy (e.g., claims against the officers or directors) are joined in litigation with other, uncovered claims (such as claims against the corporation itself), the insurer's obligations to reimburse settlement and defense costs must be allocated or apportioned among the claims and parties involved.
